item.title: Watercraft Linux Kernel Descaled
item.description: This is the first release of Watercraft’s in house 100% rust-free Linux build. Linux 6.12.115 compiled with extra checks to ensure absolutely no rust was used in the build. The build script is available in the GitHub repository and here as build.sh. You can use it to build your own descaled kernel locally, if you build locally please contribute back anything you think might be useful. Kernel Version: 6.12.115-2wc1 Requirements Linux computer running Watercraft 0.

item.title: Software Releases
item.description: phosphene.xyz will now be used to host software releases, complete with checksums and signatures always. Find ALL releases here Watercraft apt repo and archive keyring here Software Short Description Download Link Source Control Link Watercraft 0.1.1 A GNU + Linux distribution built from Devuan Excalibur (Debian without systemd). Ships with bash scripts that make configuring a system for Development or Entertainment on Linux a lot easier. Earliest development stages still so volunteer contributors are welcomed and user patience is appreciated.

item.title: Watercraft 0.1.1 Release
item.description: Watercraft 0.1.1 (Ketch) GitHub Repo released on GitHub as of 2026-10-15 This release contains important bug-fixes. The only things that have been updated are build scripts and provision scripts, everything else is unchanged.
